div.head: AGu 3
div.ab: [Be ðegnum ðe betogene synd.] [Ld] ⁊ gif man cyninges ðegn beteo manslihtes, gif he hine ladian dyrre, do he ðæt mid XII cininges ðegnum; gif mon ðone man betyhð, ðe bið læssa maga ðone se cyninges ðegn, ladige he hine mid XI his gelicena ⁊ mid anum cyninges ðægne—⁊ swa ægehwilcre spræce ðe mare sy ðone IIII mancussas—; ⁊ gyf he ne dyrre, gylde hit ðrygylde, swa hit man gewyrðe.

If anyone accuses a king's thegn of homicide, if he dares to clear himself, he shall do so with [the oaths of] twelve king's thegns. If anyone accuses a man who belongs to a lower order that that of king's thegn, he shall clear himself with [the oaths of] eleven of his equals and one king's thegn. And this law shall apply to every suit which involves an amount greater than 4 mancuses. And if he [the accused] dare not [attempt to clear himself], he shall pay [as compensation] three times the amount at which the stolen property is valued.
⁊ gif man cynges ðegen beteo manslihtas, ⁊ he hine ladian durre, do hé þæt mid XII cynges þegnas; ⁊ gyf mon þone man betyhð, þe bið læssa maga,ladie hine XI his gelicena ⁊ anum cyninges ðegene.
